key.name: view-mode
key.description: Show both panes, the source editor only, or the preview only.

key.name: remote-images
key.summary: Load remote images in the preview
key.description: Fetch HTTP and HTTPS images referenced by the current document. Disabled by default to prevent tracking and requests to local network services.

key.name: appearance
key.description: Follow the system preference or force light or dark mode.

key.name: load-demo-on-startup
key.summary: Load the demo document on startup
key.description: Show the bundled Markdown demo as an untitled document when the application opens without a file.

key.name: sync-scroll
key.description: Keep the editor and preview panes at the same relative scroll position.

key.name: autocomplete-links
key.description: Turn a typed [] into []() and place the cursor inside the parentheses.

key.name: auto-pairing
key.description: Insert, skip, and delete matching brackets, quotes, and Markdown markers while typing.

key.name: format-on-save
key.description: Normalize headings, list spacing, block quotes, tables, blank lines and code fences before writing a file.

key.name: restore-session
key.description: Reopen file windows from the previous session when the application starts without a file.

key.name: session-files
key.description: Absolute paths of file-backed windows that were open when the application last exited.

key.name: session-active
key.summary: Active file in the previous session
key.description: Path of the window that had focus when the application last exited.

key.name: recent-files
key.description: Most recently opened or saved file paths, newest first.

key.name: autosave
key.description: Write unsaved document text to the recovery directory at the configured interval.

key.name: autosave-interval
key.description: Seconds between recovery drafts for dirty documents.

key.name: backup-files
key.description: Write a timestamped copy of the previous text when saving a file.

key.name: backup-retention
key.description: Number of timestamped backups to keep for each file.

key.name: export-font-size
key.description: Base text size in points for PDF exports. Headings, code, tables and captions scale with it.

key.name: vim-mode
key.description: Enable modal Vim editing in the source editor and Vim-style navigation and search in the preview.

key.name: spell-check
key.description: Underline words that are not in the selected dictionary.

key.name: spell-language
key.description: Language code for the dictionary. An empty value uses the provider default.
